description: Returns one Citation Scan by id: its website, category, country, status and dates, the named competitors (competitor_domains), and once completed its results: the ranking of every domain the answers cited with each one's share of answered cells, the coverage (how many answer cells were filled), each answer cell's question, engine, whether the scanned website was cited and which domains were, and where the scan asked them, the head-to-head questions against named competitors. results is null until the scan completes; on a completed scan whose stored results could not be read, results_unavailable is true and the results are in the Yellowhead app. The citations are what the engines answered when asked; they can differ between runs and are not on their own evidence of why a site was or was not cited. The cited page addresses are in the Yellowhead app.
name: get_citation_scan
title: Get a Citation Scan
